scope: Forward preprocessing only; fixed before any candidate kernel source exists. Stage2 needs its own pre-implementation gradient calibration if retained in this task.
floor_definition: Maximum predecessor FP32-vs-FP64 error per operation and dtype tuple over declared ordinary finite calibration population; input already rounded to declared raw dtype. Endpoints are reported separately, never included to inflate these limits.
zero_reference: Every zero reference element must have zero absolute error; all-zero tensors must match exactly. No additive tolerance.

norm_ulp.fp32_above_one: Not automatically accepted. Report both predecessor and correctly rounded FP64 ULP, locate reduction/sqrt/division boundary and obtain PM review per specification. Existing predecessor maxima2/3 are observations, not a replacement limit.

semantic_endpoints: Preserve predecessor FP32 operation sequence at overflow/underflow/nonfinite endpoints; compare zero/NaN/Inf/sign masks and finite values against actual predecessor, report FP64 ideal discrepancy separately. If silicon differs, retain failure and RISK; no automatic exemption or new numerical guard.
performance: actual Torch NPU and predecessor same-device three synchronized old/new/old rounds; no speed threshold
